name: Crossroads Executive & Charter
tagline: Executive and charter flying from the Crossroads of America.

divisions.name: Executive
divisions.summary: Light jets out of Indianapolis Executive. Quick hops to Teterboro, Chicago and Nashville, and longer legs to Aspen, Scottsdale and Key West.

divisions.name: Global Executive
divisions.summary: The Longitude, both Gulfstreams and VIP-configured Airbus jets up to the A380, flying coast to coast and across the Atlantic to London Luton and Paris Le Bourget.

divisions.name: Group & Sports Charter
divisions.summary: Teams, tours and getaways in the E-Jets and the 757, from Indianapolis to Orlando, Las Vegas, Boston and Los Angeles.

divisions.name: Cargo Charter
divisions.summary: A300-600F, MD-11F and 777F freighters on ad-hoc runs to Miami, Ontario, Anchorage and Leipzig.
